findings: The current WP507 donor CausalProbeArm exposes only INTERVENTION_BROADCAST and CONTROL_NO_BROADCAST.
The control arm explicitly forbids broadcast identity/digest binding.
WITHHELD_BROADCAST is representable, but SHUFFLED_RECIPIENT_BROADCAST and SEMANTIC_PLACEBO_BROADCAST are not representable as controls in the current donor ABI.
The DoWhy E2 three-control proposal is therefore falsified as a direct current-ABI implementation; only 1/3 declared negative-control classes is expressible.
A full DoWhy runtime dependency is not justified by this result because the blocker is F2 control-arm identity semantics, not missing statistical machinery.

architecture_delta.counterhypothesis: The existing intervention/no-broadcast pair may already be sufficient for immediate WP507 component acceptance; additional placebo/shuffle control types may add surface without incremental falsification value.

next_discriminator: Wait for canonical WP507 G3 source materialization or an explicitly admitted exact-PR-head E4 lane, then compare the current two-arm contract against a separate typed broadcast-bearing negative-control primitive on semantic-placebo and recipient-shuffle confounds. Adopt only on demonstrated incremental information gain.
evidence_boundary: Mirror of F2 E3 source-equivalent ABI reproduction/falsification; no independent replication and no higher-scope promotion.
